Federico Molinari is a retired Argentine gymnast, known for his contributions to the sport, particularly in artistic gymnastics. Born on February 5, 1984, in Buenos Aires, Argentina, he gained recognition for his performances in various international competitions.

Molinari specialized in rings and floor exercises, where he showcased his skills and garnered medals during his career. He represented Argentina at several prestigious events, including the Pan American Games and the World Championships. One of his notable achievements was winning multiple medals at the Pan American Championships.

Federico Molinari also competed in the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, where he represented his country in gymnastics. His participation in the Olympics marked a significant milestone in his career, allowing him to compete on one of the world's biggest athletic stages.

After retiring from competitive gymnastics, Molinari has been involved in promoting the sport and inspiring younger generations of athletes. His accomplishments have made him a prominent figure in Argentine gymnastics.
